title: Find the display names of users who have earned both 'Teacher' and 'Support
question: Find the display names of users who have earned both 'Teacher' and 'Supporter' badges and have posted at least one question that received more than 2 votes.

prediction.sql:
SELECT u."XCL_055" AS display_name
FROM users AS u
WHERE u."XCL_052" IN (
    SELECT b."XCL_002"
    FROM badges AS b
    WHERE b."XCL_003" IN ('Teacher', 'Supporter')
    GROUP BY b."XCL_002"
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b."XCL_003") = 2
)
AND u."XCL_052" IN (
    SELECT p."XCL_033"
    FROM posts AS p
    JOIN votes AS v ON p."XCL_026" = v."XCL_067"
    WHERE p."XCL_027" = 1
    GROUP BY p."XCL_026"
    HAVING COUNT(v."XCL_066") > 2
)
